scope: For an ordinary 2D or 3D POLYLINE written through the facade into AC1021 model space, index its parent once in the model BLOCK_HEADER; its VERTEX and SEQEND records remain owned by the POLYLINE and are not also listed as block-owned entities. Mesh/polyface, paper-space, named-block and other DWG versions keep the prior behavior pending separate evidence.

physical_source.provenance: Scratch DXF authored with ezdxf and converted to AC1021 by ODA File Converter 27.1.0; no drawing fixture is added.
physical_source.independent_observation: GNU LibreDWG 0.14 JSON reports model BLOCK_HEADER entities=[POLYLINE 0x2F], POLYLINE owned vertices 0x31/0x32/0x33 and SEQEND 0x30 (role 3), and each vertex/SEQEND owner role 4 to 0x2F. Its points are (0,0,0), (5,0,0), (5,3,0). The previous generated source instead lists the parent, all three vertices and SEQEND as model-block entities despite each child's parent handle pointing to the POLYLINE.

isolated_factorial.method: Scratch-only edits first varied SEQEND handle allocation and frame emission order individually and together; all variants retained the failed ODA 2D result. A second factorial omitted VERTEX/SEQEND from the AC1021 modern BLOCK_HEADER list and varied parent owned-handle roles; GNU LibreDWG confirmed that the input BLOCK_HEADER listed the parent only and that the three vertices/owners/points remained present. The actual modern writer override was verified; an earlier scratch attempt to change the inherited writer15 implementation did not affect AC1021 and is not counted.
isolated_factorial.result: ODA returned all three original 2D vertex handles and points with both role-3 and role-5 child references, so the list correction is independently causal for this selected 2D case. With the separate exact 3D object footer control, ODA returned all three 3D points (0,0,0), (5,0,1), (5,3,2) and vertex flag 32; list correction without that footer still failed at readFile. The final production 3D result requires both fixes.
isolated_factorial.limits: These factorial DWGs use diagnostic scratch writer variants, not the final production binary; later combined production evidence is recorded separately. ODA produced the selected DXFs; this selected-entity check does not qualify complete-file behavior.

implementation: A one-shot per-writer permit scoped to the exact VERTEX or SEQEND passed by dwgRW::writePolyline is consumed before the modern encoder performs further work, and suppresses block ownership only for AC1021 model-space POLYLINE, with no active named block and neither mesh nor polyface flags. Both implicit and explicit model BLOCK_RECORD handles are accepted; the writer normalizes the latter before emitting. That profile takes its existing complete checkpoint before any reservation so preflight and later failures can roll back object, block and caller state. Paper-space, named-block and non-AC1021 paths retain the previous fast batch checkpoint. An exception guard restores snapshots and the caller-mutation ledger, latches required-write failure, and retains the full checkpoint until potentially throwing allocation and copies finish; receipt/counter publication uses no-throw moves. Compatibility narrowing: the block-owned entity index no longer contains these child records, so GROUP targets referring to these previously indexed VERTEX or SEQEND identities now fail closed; the POLYLINE parent remains an admissible GROUP target. A failed GROUP callback latches required-write failure even when the caller ignores its result.

validation.result: 3/3 passed. The fixture-free test covers implicit/explicit AC1021 model 2D/3D parent-only membership, paper-space and AC1024 controls, preflight/SEQEND failure rollback and retry, and injected early/late allocation exceptions. The exception checks verify raw EED references, caller parent owner/space/SEQEND and child owner/space/subtype, outer transaction, writer objects and block list, receipts/counters, required-failure latch, destination sentinel and same-facade fresh-write retry. Multiversion and AC1015 legacy controls also pass. A GROUP targeting a previously indexed child fails even if its callback result is ignored and preserves the prior destination; the same facade retries successfully with the parent target, whose group identity, owner and member are verified by native readback.

remaining: Qualify mesh/polyface, paper-space and named-block POLYLINE membership and the corresponding modern versions independently. This result does not qualify arbitrary complete DWG output or native CAD application semantics.
authority: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 §§20.4.16–17 describe R2004+ POLYLINE hard-owned VERTEX list and SEQEND; §20.4.52 describes the BLOCK_HEADER hard-owned entity list. The physical witness demonstrates the selected model-space nesting.
address_sanitizer: Final combined candidate: libdxfrw_dwg_ac1021_polyline_block_membership and libdxfrw_dwg_r2007_polyline3d_footer passed 2/2 under AddressSanitizer.
